If the operating temperature range is narrower than 16 to 40 °C (60.8 to 104.0 °F) as specified in 5.6.1.1, the device shall be clearly labeled with a cautionary statement of the maximum or minimum operating temperatures, or both. The product's operating temperature is 10℃-40℃, which is narrower than 16-40°C at the lower end, making this clause applicable.

Storage Conditions: The instrument shall meet the accuracy requirements of 5.3 or 5.4, or both, after having been stored or transported, or both, at any point in an environment of -20 to +50 °C (-4 to +122 °F) and relative humidity up to 95%, noncondensing, for a period of one month. The test procedure is specified in 6.1.6. Result: See TABLE 5.6.4. Verdict: P.

An IR thermometer that is intended for professional use shall meet the accuracy requirements of 5.3 or 5.4, or both, for temperature ranges of 6.3.2, during and after exposure to electromagnetic interference. This requirement is not applicable as the device is not intended for professional use.

Labeling requirement 5.10.1.3: An IR thermometer intended for professional use shall be conspicuously labelled with an indication of the unadjusted or adjusted mode(s). Such labeling is optional for IR thermometers that display only one mode and are intended for non-professional use. However, the instruction manual for both professional and non-professional use IR thermometers shall specify the body site(s) used to reference the adjusted temperature value(s) displayed. This clause is N/A as the device is for non-professional use.

Housing Materials requirement (5.9.1): All materials that may come in contact with the operator or a subject shall be nontoxic. Compliance evidence referenced to Biocompatibility test report provided by manufacturer. Result marked N/E (Not Evaluated in this report).

Warning Signs specification (5.8.3): The instrument shall have means to inform the operator when the following are outside the operating ranges specified by the manufacturer: power supply, subject temperature, and ambient temperature. Implementation: Low power supply warning threshold is 2.7V; outside the operating temperature range and ambient temperature are indicated by displaying '---'.

For Skin Type IR Thermometer testing (6.1.5), blackbody temperatures shall be set within ±1 °C (±2 °F) from 23 °C, 30 °C, and 38 °C (73, 86, and 100 °F). Testing procedure follows 6.1.4 requirements: stabilization for minimum 30 min, at least six measurements per blackbody temperature per ambient condition combination, new disposable probe cover for each test reading if applicable. Three data sets formed per mode; greatest calculated error δj shall conform with requirements in 5.4.

Storage Test (6.1.6): An IR thermometer shall be maintained in an environmental chamber at –20 °C (–4 °F), relative humidity below 50%, for 30 days; and at 50 °C (122 °F), relative humidity no less than 75% noncondensing, for 30 days. After each exposure, the IR thermometer shall be tested according to 6.3.2 and 6.3.3.

Sampling Plans (6.1): Tests are not required for every produced instrument. Each producer or distributor representing its instruments as conforming to this specification shall utilize statistically based sampling plans appropriate for each particular manufacturing process, in the design qualification of the device, and shall keep essential records to document with a high degree of assurance that all requirements are met. The manufacturer shall make sampling plans available upon request.

Clinical Accuracy Tests (6.2): This specification does not prescribe an actual method for determining clinical accuracy or establish specifications for values which characterize clinical accuracy. Manufacturers shall perform clinical accuracy testing in accordance with methods acceptable to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. An example method is provided in X2.3.

Blackbody Test (6.1.3): Under laboratory conditions, an IR thermometer shall be tested against a blackbody standard. A recommended blackbody design is provided in Annex A1. The temperature of the blackbody shall be measured by the IR thermometer being tested in accordance with a procedure recommended by the manufacturer. The true temperature of the blackbody shall be monitored by a contact imbedded or immersed thermometer with uncertainty no greater than ±0.03 °C (±0.05 °F). A manufacturer may require testing only with a manufacturer-specified blackbody rather than that described in Annex A1.

Clinical accuracy tests are intended for evaluation of accuracy of built-in instrumentational or combined site offsets, or both, and performance of an IR thermometer in assessing internal body temperatures from actual subjects. While this specification does not set limits for clinical accuracy, it is the responsibility of a manufacturer to determine values characterizing clinical accuracy and disclose them upon request.

Shock Test Procedure (6.3.1): IR thermometer subjected to fall from 1 m onto 50 mm thick hardwood board (density >700 kg/m3) on rigid base (concrete block). Controlled orientation: once for each of two axes where probe faces down. Axis A = optical axis of probe; Axis B = passes through center of gravity and point where probe window crosses Axis A.

Post-shock measurement verification (6.3.2): Measure blackbody set within ±0.5°C (±1°F) from 37°C (98.6°F). Ambient conditions: 20-26°C (68-79°F), RH 40-70%. Minimum 5 measurements with new disposable probe cover per measurement. IR thermometer set in unadjusted mode per 5.8.2.2.

EMC test for non-continuous reading devices (6.4.2.4): IR thermometers not capable of producing continuous temperature readings shall have their circuitry modified to allow for continuous monitoring of IR and reference temperature signals. The peak excursions of the monitored IR and reference temperature signals measured during frequency sweep interval shall be recalculated to represent the corresponding temperature excursions. On request, the manufacturer shall make available the method of the circuit modification.

In order that purchasers may identify products conforming to requirements of this specification, producers and distributors may include a statement of compliance in conjunction with their name and address on product labels or associated printed materials, or both, such as invoices, sales literature, and the like. The following statement is suggested: 'This infrared thermometer meets requirements established in ASTM Standard (E1965-98). Full responsibility for the conformance of this product to the standard is assumed by (name and address of producer or distributor).' In the event one or more provisions of this standard are not met, a cautionary statement shall be included.

The instruction manual shall contain adequate instructions for use with sufficient detail for training in the operation, application, care, and biological and physical cleaning of the instrument and accessories. The instruction manual shall include warnings if performance of the instrument may be adversely affected should one or more of specified conditions occur (operation outside subject temperature range, operation outside operating temperature and humidity ranges, storage outside ambient temperature and humidity ranges, mechanical shock, soiled or damaged infrared optical components, absent/defective/soiled probe cover, use of unspecified probe covers).

ASTM laboratory accuracy requirements in the display range of 37 to 39 °C (98 to 102 °F) for IR thermometers is ± 0.2 °C (±0.4 °F), whereas for mercury-in-glass and electronic thermometers, the requirement per ASTM Standards E667-86 and E1112-86 is ± 0.1 °C (±0.2 °F).

The largest δj is a measure of the laboratory error of a system.

Reference temperature source total uncertainty is consistently 0.06°C across all test conditions (Shock, Storage Conditions, Cleaning and Disinfection, Electrostatic Discharge, Low Power Supply Operation).

Individual measurement error formula: δ = |tj - tBB|, where tj is the displayed or calculated value of unadjusted temperature, tBB is the true temperature of the blackbody, j is the sequential number of a reading, and || signifies taking an absolute value. semantic_fragments.content: ESD Test Setup Procedure: Contact discharge was applied only to conductive surfaces of the EUT. Air discharge was applied only to non-conducted surfaces of the EUT. The EUT was put on a 0.8m high wooden table for table-top equipment or 0.1m high for floor standing equipment standing on the ground reference plane (GRP). A horizontal coupling plane (HCP) 1.6m by 0.8m in size was placed on the table, and the EUT with its cables were isolated from the HCP by an insulating support thicker than 0.5mm. The VCP 0.5m by 0.5m in size while HCP were constructed from the same material type and thickness as that of the GRP, and connected to the GRP via a 470kΩ resistor at each end. The distance between EUT and any of the other metallic surfaces except the GRP, HCP and VCP was greater than 1m. During the contact discharges, the tip of the discharge electrode touched the EUT before the discharge switch is operated. During the air discharges, the round discharge tip of the discharge electrode was approached as fast as possible to touch the EUT. After each discharge, the ESD generator was removed from the EUT, the generator is then retriggered for a new single discharge. For ungrounded product, a discharge cable with two resistances was used after each discharge to remove remnant electrostatic voltage. 10 times of each polarity single discharge were applied to HCP and VCP.

semantic_fragments.content: Radiated Immunity Test Setup and Procedure (Section 6.3.1): 1. For table-top equipment, the EUT was placed in the chamber on a non-conductive table 0.8m high. For arrangement of floor-standing equipment, the EUT was mounted on a non-conductive support 0.1m above the supporting plane. 2. If possible, a minimum of 1m of cable is exposed to the electromagnetic field. Excess length of cables interconnecting units of the EUT shall be bundled low-inductively in the approximate center of the cable to form a bundle 30cm to 40cm in length. 3. The EUT was initially placed with one face coincident with the calibration plane. The EUT face being illuminated was contained within the UFA (Uniform Field Area). 4. The frequency ranges to be considered were swept with the signal modulated and pausing to adjust the RF signal level or to switch oscillators and Antennas as necessary. The frequency range was swept incrementally, the step size was not exceed 1% of the preceding frequency value. 5. The dwell time of the amplitude modulated carrier at each frequency was not less than the time necessary for the EUT to be exercised and to respond, and was not less than 0.5s. 6. The test normally was performed with the generating Antenna facing each side of the EUT. 7. The polarization of the field generated by each Antenna necessitates testing each selected side twice, once with the Antenna positioned vertically and again with the Antenna positioned horizontally. 8. The EUT was performed in a configuration to actual installation conditions, a video camera and/or an audio monitor were used to monitor the performance of the EUT.

semantic_fragments.content: Proximity Fields from RF Wireless Communications Equipment Test Setup and Procedure (Section 6.4.1): 1. For table-top equipment, the EUT was placed in the chamber on a non-conductive table 0.8m high. For arrangement of floor-standing equipment, the EUT was mounted on a non-conductive support 0.1m above the supporting plane. 2. If possible, a minimum of 1m of cable is exposed to the electromagnetic field. Excess length of cables interconnecting units of the EUT shall be bundled low-inductively in the approximate center of the cable to form a bundle 30cm to 40cm in length. 3. The EUT was initially placed with one face coincident with the calibration plane. The EUT face being illuminated was contained within the UFA (Uniform Field Area). 4. The test distances between Antenna and EUT are 3m for frequencies between 1970MHz and 5785MHz and 2.5m for frequencies between 385MHz and 1970MHz. 5. The dwell time of the amplitude modulated carrier at each frequency was not less than the time necessary for the EUT to be exercised and to respond, and was not less than 1s. 6. The test normally was performed with the generating Antenna facing each side of the EUT. 7. The polarization of the field generated by each Antenna necessitates testing each selected side twice, once with the Antenna positioned vertically and again with the Antenna positioned horizontally. 8. The EUT was performed in a configuration to actual installation conditions, a video camera and/or an audio monitor were used to monitor the performance of the EUT.

semantic_fragments.content: 6.5.1 EFT Test Setup and Procedure: The EUT was placed on a ground reference plane (GRP) insulated by an insulating support 0.1m thick and the GRP was placed on a 0.8m high wooden table for table-top equipment. For floor standing equipment, the EUT was placed on a 0.1m high wooden support above the GRP. The GRP shall project beyond the EUT and the clamp by at least 0.1m on all sides. The distance between the EUT and any other metallic surface except the GRP was greater than 0.5m. All cables to the EUT were placed on the insulation support 0.1m above GRP. Cables not subject to EFT were routed as far as possible from cable under test to minimize coupling. The length of signal and power cable between the EUT and EFT generator was 0.5m. If the cable is a non-detachable supply cable more than 0.5m, the excess length shall be folded to avoid a flat coil and situated at 0.1m above the GRP. The EUT was conducted the below specified level voltage test for line to neutral or line to neutral to earth (for clamp coupling is for the signal line), 120 seconds duration. If the equipment contains identical ports, only one was tested; multiconductor cables tested as a single cable; cables did not be split or divided into groups of conductors; interface ports intended to be connected to data cables not longer than 3m did not be tested. During the test, the EUT was tested with the hand-held parts terminated with artificial hand.

semantic_fragments.content: 6.6.1 Test Setup and Procedure for Surge Immunity: The EUT was placed on a ground reference plane (GRP) insulated by an insulating support 0.1m thick and the GRP was placed on a 0.8m high wooden table for table-top equipment. For floor standing equipment, the EUT was placed on a 0.1m high wooden support above the GRP. The 1.2/50 µs surge was applied to the EUT power supply Terminals via the capacitive coupling network. Decoupling networks were required to avoid adverse effects on equipment not under test. The power cord and interconnection line between the EUT and the coupling/decoupling network shall not exceed 2m in length. Test voltages: 1kV for line to line and line to neutral; 2kV for line to earth and neutral to earth. Five positive and five negative pulses at 90° and 270° for AC ports, five positive and five negative pulses for DC ports. Generator source impedance: 2Ω for power supply terminals, 40Ω for interconnection lines. Repetition rate: 1 per minute.

semantic_fragments.content: 6.7.1 Test Setup and Procedure for Conducted Immunity 0.15 MHz to 80 MHz: The EUT was placed on an insulating support 0.1m height above a ground reference plane. All cables exiting the EUT were supported at least 30 mm above the ground reference plane. Coupling and decoupling devices were located between 0.1m and 0.3m from the EUT. Each AE used with clamp injection was placed on an insulating support 0.1m above the ground reference plane. Decoupling networks were installed on each cable between EUT and AE except the cable under test. Frequency swept from 150 kHz to 80 MHz with 80% amplitude modulation with 1 kHz sine wave. Frequency step size ≤1% of preceding frequency value. Dwell time ≥0.5 s. EUT hand-held parts terminated with artificial hand during test.

semantic_fragments.content: Test setup for power frequency magnetic field immunity: The EUT was placed on a ground reference plane (GRP) insulated by an insulating support 0.1m thick and the GRP was placed on a 0.8m high wooden table for table-top equipment. For floor standing equipment, the EUT was placed on a 0.1m high wooden support above the GRP. The EUT was configured and connected to satisfy its functional requirements. The power supply, input and output circuits was connected to the sources of power supply, control and signal. The cables supplied or recommended by the equipment manufacturer were used. In absence of any recommendation, unshielded cables were adopted, of a type appropriate for the signals involved. All cables were exposed to the magnetic field for 1m of their length. The EUT was subjected to the test magnetic field by using the induction coil of standard dimensions (1m×1m) by the immersion method. The induction coil was then be rotated by 90° in order to expose the EUT to the test field with different orientations. For floor-standing equipment the test was repeated by moving and shifting the induction coils, in order to test the whole volume of the EUT for each orthogonal direction.

This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members' health conditions easily and quickly.

Possible test case verdicts: N/A - test case does not apply to the test object; Pass (P) - test object does meet the requirement; N/E - test object was not evaluated for the requirement; Fail (F) - test object does not meet the requirement. Abbreviations: N.C. = normal condition; S.F.C. = single fault condition; MOOP = means of Operator protection; MOPP = means of Patient protection.
Test laboratory: Tianxu(Tianjin)Testing Technology Service Co.,LTD, Address: 101, First floor, Building L, No.3 JinPing Street, Ya An Road, Nankai District, Tianjin, China.
The test results presented in this report relate only to the object tested. Without permission of the Report department this test report is not permitted to be duplicated in extracts.

Insulation diagram is a graphical representation of equipment insulation barriers, protective impedance and protective earthing. Conventions: All isolation barriers are identified by letters between separate parts of diagram, for example separate transformer windings, optocouplers, wire insulation, creepage and clearance distances. Parts connected to earth with large dots are protectively earthed. Other connections to earth are functional. Applied parts are extended beyond the equipment enclosure and terminated with an arrow. Parts accessible to the operator only are extended outside of the enclosure, but are not terminated with an arrow.

A measured value must be provided in the value columns for the device under evaluation. The symbol > (greater than sign) must not be used. EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE stated in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE as 5 years. This is per Clause 4.4 of IEC60601-1.

No alternative means of addressing particular RISKS were provided or used. Per Clause 4.5, alternative means must be justified by the MANUFACTURER showing RESIDUAL RISKS are comparable to those resulting from standard requirements, based on scientific data, clinical opinion, or comparative studies.

No COMPONENT WITH HIGH-INTEGRITY CHARACTERISTICS was used in this ME EQUIPMENT per Clause 4.9. No evaluation of such components for conditions of use and reasonably foreseeable misuse during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE was required.

All components and wiring are used within their specified ratings. Reliability of components used as MEANS OF PROTECTION was assessed for conditions of use in ME EQUIPMENT. Components complied with applicable safety requirements of relevant IEC or ISO standards (see appended table 8.10).

Environmental test conditions: Temperature 10℃-40℃; Relative Humidity 15%RH-95%RH; Atmospheric Pressure 700hPa-1060hPa. Test lab environment under controlled conditions. Test results of excessive temperature were adjusted to ambient temperature 40℃.

For units rated higher than IPX0, test time extended to 168 hours. Manually detachable parts removed and treated concurrently with major parts; manually removable ACCESS COVERS opened and detached.
Clause 5.8: Unless stated otherwise, tests in this standard are sequenced as in Annex B to prevent influencing results of any subsequent test.

Clause 5.9.2.1: Accessibility, when necessary, determined using standard test finger of Fig 6 applied in a bent or straight position. At least markings in 7.2.2, 7.2.5, 7.2.6 (not for PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT), 7.2.10, and 7.2.13 were applied when size of EQUIPMENT, its part, an ACCESSORY, or ENCLOSURE did not permit application of all required markings. The ME EQUIPMENT is classified as IP22 per IEC 60529, uses TYPE BF APPLIED PARTS with Symbol 20 (IEC 60417-5333), is intended for CONTINUOUS OPERATION, has no accessible fuse-holder, no high voltage terminal devices, no special cooling provisions, no socket-outlets, no type B or type CF applied parts, no defibrillation-proof applied parts, and no special packaging instructions. Momentary-on push buttons must use IEC 60417-5011 or equivalent status indication. All sub-clauses under 7.4.1 are marked N/A for this device.

Two MEANS OF PROTECTION are required for ME EQUIPMENT to prevent APPLIED and other ACCESSIBLE PARTS from exceeding limits in 8.4. Each MEANS OF PROTECTION must be categorized as either a MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION (MOPP) or a MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION (MOOP), taking into account Clause 4.6 and the flow chart in Fig A.12. Varnishing, enamelling, oxidation, and similar protective finishes and coatings with sealing compounds re-plasticizing at temperatures expected during operation and sterilization are disregarded as MEANS OF PROTECTION. Components and wiring forming a MEANS OF PROTECTION must comply with 8.10. Insulation, CREEPAGE, CLEARANCES, components or earth connections not complying with 8.5.1.2 and 8.5.1.3 are not considered as MEANS OF PROTECTION, and failure of these parts is regarded as NORMAL CONDITION.

MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION (MOPP) requirements under 8.5.1.2: Solid insulation forming a MOPP must comply with dielectric strength test of Clause 8.8 at the test voltage specified in Table 6. CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES forming a MOPP must comply with Table 12. PROTECTIVE EARTH CONNECTIONS forming a MOPP must comply with Cl. 8.6. A Y (Y1 or Y2) capacitor complying with IEC 60384-14 is considered one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION. A single Y1 capacitor may be used for two MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION when the working voltage is less than 42.4 V peak a.c. or 60 V d.c.

Points at which impedances of components, CREEPAGE, CLEARANCES, PROTECTIVE EARTH CONNECTIONS or insulation, prevent ACCESSIBLE PARTS from exceeding limits in 8.4 examined whether a failure at any of these points is to be regarded as a NORMAL or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION. A MEANS OF PROTECTION protecting APPLIED PARTS, or parts identified by 4.6 as parts subject to the same requirements, considered MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION. A MEANS OF PROTECTION protecting other parts considered MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION.

PATIENT CONNECTIONS treated as one APPLIED PART in the absence of electrical separation between PATIENT CONNECTIONS of same or another function. MANUFACTURER has defined if multiple functions are to be considered as all within one APPLIED PART or as multiple APPLIED PARTS.

ME equipment or ME system with essential performance intended to actively keep alive or resuscitate a patient shall maintain its essential performance for a sufficient time or for a sufficient number of procedures when loss or failure of supply mains or near depletion of internal electrical power source occurred. The time or number of procedures remaining shall allow alternative life-supporting methods to be employed. Instructions for use shall disclose the time or number of procedures available following such loss or failure. ME equipment without internal electrical power source intended to keep alive patients shall be equipped with an alarm system including at least a medium priority alarm condition indicating power failure. ME equipment with internal electrical power source intended to keep alive patients shall be equipped with automatic switchover to internal electrical power source and an alarm indicating internal electrical power source is nearing insufficient remaining power.

For ME EQUIPMENT or ME SYSTEM with an INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE, if simultaneous connection of the ME EQUIPMENT to the PATIENT and the SUPPLY MAINS is possible, then APPLIED PARTS and parts that are likely to come into contact with the PATIENT shall have two MOPP from the SUPPLY MAINS. However, parts which the PATIENT intentionally handles as the intended OPERATOR (e.g. touch keys, ENCLOSURE) while the ME EQUIPMENT is not being used for its intended medical function may be insulated with two MOOP from SUPPLY MAINS.

semantic_fragments.content: TZ1临床测量试验C组（成人组）共纳入76名受试者，年龄范围6至52岁，包含男女两性。每名受试者使用TZ1体温计进行三次重复测量（tij1、tij2、tij3），同时记录参考体温计读数（tRi）。计算每次测量相对于参考体温计的临床偏差（△tb1、△tb2、△tb3），偏差范围在-0.3℃至+0.2℃之间。同时记录三次测量中最大值与最小值之差RRi（Tmax-Tmin），以及重复性指标SRi。RRi最大值为0.2℃，SRi最大值为0.1212。
semantic_fragments._source: 附件1：TZ1准确度的验证报告.via_lo_html.clean.md

semantic_fragments.content: 成人组临床试验数据（受试者编号77-99）：记录每位受试者的性别、年龄、玻璃水银体温计参考值（tRi）、红外体温计三次测量值（ti1、ti2、ti3）及三次偏差（△ti1、△ti2、△ti3），以及最大偏差绝对值和最大偏差绝对值/0.165的比值。三次测量临床偏差均值△tb=0.004℃，标准偏差Sb=0.1038℃，单组临床重复性SR=0.078℃，P值>0.05，提示红外体温计与玻璃水银体温计测量结果之间差异无统计学意义。

requirements.reference: IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, Clause 11 applies except as follows

requirements.description: Cleaning and disinfection of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEM

sub_requirements.description: The surfaces of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES that can become contaminated with body fluids during NORMAL CONDITION or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION shall be designed to allow for cleaning and disinfection or cleaning and sterilization
The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may be dismantled during the decontamination PROCESS
ACCESSORIES not intended for re-use are exempt from this requirement

CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE ENCLOSURES shall be designed to allow for surface cleaning and disinfection to reduce to acceptable levels the RISK of infection of OPERATORS, bystanders, or the PATIENT
Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES shall comply with ISO 17664:2004 and ISO 14937:2009 and shall be disclosed in the instructions for use

Check compliance by inspection of the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Clean and disinfect 100 times in accordance with the methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained.

requirements.description: Biocompatibility of ME EQUIPMENT and ME

sub_requirements.description: ACCESSIBLE PARTS of a CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE, its parts or ACCESSORIES that contain phthalates which are classified as carcinogenic, mutagenic or toxic to reproduction shall be marked as containing phthalates on the device itself or on the packaging

If INTENDED USE includes treatment of children or treatment of pregnant or nursing women, a specific justification for the use of phthalates shall be included in the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Instructions for use shall contain information on RESIDUAL RISKS for these PATIENT groups and appropriate precautionary measures.

requirements.title: ACCURACY OF CONTROLS AND INSTRUMENTS AND PROTECTION AGAINST HAZARDOUS OUTPUTS

requirements.description: If the CLINICAL THERMOMETER cannot indicate a temperature within the LABORATORY ACCURACY, it either provides a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or it does not provide an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE

requirements.title: Minimum RATED OUTPUT RANGE
requirements.description: Minimum RATED OUTPUT RANGE of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER is from 34°C to 42°C

requirements.title: Additional requirements for USABILITY
requirements.description: CLINICAL THERMOMETERS intended for home healthcare use require the display of OUTPUT TEMPERATURE of at least 4mm or the value is optically magnified to this height

requirements.title: Segmented indication display functional test

requirements.description: PROBES, PROBE CABLE EXTENDERS and PROBE COVERS comply with the requirements of this particular standard

MANUFACTURERS of PROBES, PROBE CABLE EXTENDERS and PROBE COVERS conduct tests to ensure that all CLINICAL THERMOMETER specifications are met with each MODEL OR TYPE REFERENCE of CLINICAL THERMOMETER with which they are intended to be used
All CLINICAL THERMOMETERS with which compatibility to the PROBES, PROBE CABLE EXTENDERS and PROBE COVERS is claimed are listed in the ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT

It is the responsibility of the MANUFACTURER of a PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER and PROBE COVER, including a REPROCESSED PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER and PROBE COVER, to have their PROCESSES VALIDATED to ensure that any new or REPROCESSED product complies with the requirements of this particular standard
At least one MODEL OR TYPE REFERENCE of CLINICAL THERMOMETER is included in the ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT provided with each PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER and PROBE COVER
Accompanying document shall include statement: Designed for use with specific thermometer or monitoring equipment
requirements.label: a

requirements.description: Accompanying document shall include statement: The OPERATOR is responsible for checking the compatibility of the thermometer or monitoring equipment, PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER AND PROBE COVER before use
requirements.label: b

requirements.description: Accompanying document shall include statement: Incompatible components can result in degraded performance
requirements.label: c

requirements.description: Component failures associated with BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE shall not be allowed
Changes in programmable parameters or settings associated with BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE shall not be allowed
Reset to default settings associated with BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE shall not be allowed
Change of operating mode associated with BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE shall not be allowed

Change in LABORATORY ACCURACY at any point in the RATED OUTPUT RANGE and in the RATED EXTENDED OUTPUT RANGE greater than permitted in 201.101.2 without the generation of either a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or an indication of abnormal operation shall not be allowed
In the event of disruption during IMMUNITY tests, the CLINICAL THERMOMETER shall recover from any disruption within 30 s
An ADJUSTED MODE CLINICAL THERMOMETER that makes continuous estimates of the REFERENCE BODY SITE temperature is exempt from the requirements of this subclause

requirements.title: General applicability
requirements.description: The following requirements shall apply to any IR thermometer that is labeled to meet these specifications.

requirements.title: Ear canal IR thermometer displayed temperature range
requirements.description: In any display mode, an ear canal IR thermometer shall display a subject's temperature over a minimum range of 34.4 to 42.2 °C (94.0 to 108.0 °F).
requirements.result_remark: No ear mode

requirements.title: Skin IR thermometer displayed temperature range
requirements.description: A skin IR thermometer shall display a subject's temperature over a minimum range of 22 to 40.0 °C (71.6 to 104.0 °F).

requirements.title: Maximum Permissible Laboratory Error (Ear Canal IR Thermometer)
Laboratory error δ within manufacturer's specified operating ambient conditions
requirements.description: Within the manufacturer's specified operating ambient conditions (see 5.6), laboratory error δ as measured according to 6.1.4 shall be no greater than values specified below.

requirements.title: Ear canal blackbody temperature range 36 to 39 °C
requirements.description: For blackbody temperature range from 36 to 39 °C (96.8 to 102.2 °F): 0.2 °C (0.4 °F).
requirements.result_remark: No ear mode

requirements.title: Ear canal blackbody temperature outside 36-39 °C
requirements.description: For blackbody temperatures less than 36 °C (96.8 °F) or greater than 39 °C (102.2 °F): 0.3 °C (0.5 °F).
requirements.result_remark: No ear mode

requirements.title: Maximum Permissible Laboratory Error (Skin IR Thermometer)
Skin IR thermometer laboratory error δ
requirements.description: Within the manufacturer's specified operating ambient conditions (see 5.6) over the display temperature range as specified in 5.2.2, laboratory error δ as measured according to 6.1.5 shall be no greater than 0.3 °C (0.5 °F).
requirements.result_remark: See Table 5.6.1

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy applicability
requirements.description: The clinical accuracy requirement is applicable only to an ear canal IR thermometer system and the corresponding age groups of subjects for which such a thermometer is labeled or implied to be used.

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy determination conditions
requirements.description: Clinical accuracy shall be determined separately for each of the following conditions: for each device model, for each adjusted display mode, and for every age group of febrile and afebrile subjects on which the IR thermometer is intended to be used.
requirements.result_remark: Clinical accuracy is not evaluated in this report.

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy disclosure
requirements.description: Any disclosure of clinical accuracy claims shall be accompanied by disclosure of methodology and procedures. Such information shall be made available on request.

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy form
requirements.description: Clinical accuracy should be determined in the form of two characteristics — clinical bias with stated uncertainty and clinical repeatability, as defined in 3.2.9.

requirements.title: Laboratory error at operating temperature range 16 to 40 °C
requirements.description: The system shall meet laboratory error requirements as specified in 5.3 or 5.4, or both, when operating in an environment from 16 to 40 °C (60.8 to 104.0 °F).
requirements.result_remark: See TABLE 5.6.1

requirements.title: Labeling for narrower operating temperature range
requirements.description: If the operating temperature range is narrower than specified in 5.6.1.1, the device shall be clearly labeled with a cautionary statement of the maximum or minimum operating temperatures, or both.
requirements.result_remark: Operating temperature is 10℃-40℃.

requirements.title: Upper limit of operating temperature range
requirements.description: Under no circumstances may the upper limit of operating temperature range be less than 35 °C (95 °F).
requirements.result_remark: Operating temperature is 10℃-40℃.

requirements.title: Operating Humidity Range
requirements.description: The relative humidity range for the operating temperature range as specified in 5.6.1 is up to 95%, noncondensing.
requirements.result_remark: Operating Humidity Range: 15%-95%RH

requirements.title: Drop test with batteries installed
requirements.description: The instrument with batteries installed (if applicable) without a carrying (storage) casing shall withstand drops with controlled orientation of the device without degradation of accuracy as specified in 5.3 or 5.4, or both, for a blackbody temperature of or near 37 °C (98.6 °F), when tested according to 6.3.
requirements.result_remark: See TABLE 5.6.3

requirements.title: Shock detection mechanism
requirements.description: If an IR thermometer does not meet the requirement of 5.6.3.1, a means of detecting and informing the user of its inoperable state, after being subjected to shock, shall be provided.

requirements.title: Storage Conditions
requirements.description: The instrument shall meet the accuracy requirements of 5.3 or 5.4, or both, after having been stored or transported, or both, at any point in an environment of -20 to +50 °C (-4 to +122 °F) and relative humidity up to 95%, noncondensing, for a period of one month. The test procedure is specified in 6.1.6.
requirements.result_remark: See TABLE 5.6.4

requirements.description: Cleaning and Disinfection—Instrument performance shall not be degraded by using the manufacturer's recommended procedures for cleaning and disinfection provided in the instruction manual.

Electromagnetic Immunity—An IR thermometer that is intended for professional use shall meet the accuracy requirements of 5.3 or 5.4, or both, for temperature ranges of 6.3.2, during and after exposure to electromagnetic interference.
Electrostatic Discharge—An IR thermometer shall meet the accuracy requirements of 5.3 and 5.4, or both, for temperature ranges of 6.3.2, after 5 s after being subjected to electrostatic discharge.
Low Power Supply Operation—The instrument shall operate at power supply voltage lower by no less than 0.1 V than that required for indication of low power supply sign as specified by 5.8.3.
Display and Human Interface
Resolution—The resolution of a display shall be 0.1 °C (0.1 °F).
Modes
An IR thermometer shall indicate in what mode the instrument is set.
Unadjusted Mode—The unadjusted mode shall be accessible by the user either by setting the instrument into that mode directly or by a conversion technique from adjusted mode.
The adjusted mode sets an IR thermometer to represent a reference body site, such as core, oral, rectal, etc.
requirements.notes: Adjusted mode, reference body site: oral

requirements.description: Warning Signs—The instrument shall have means to inform the operator when the following are outside the operating ranges specified by the manufacturer: power supply, subject temperature, and ambient temperature.
requirements.notes: Low power supply: 2.7V; Outside the operating temperature range and ambient temperature show '---'

requirements.description: Construction
Housing Materials—All materials that may come in contact with the operator or a subject shall be nontoxic.
requirements.notes: See Biocompatibility test report provided by manufacturer

requirements.description: Probe Covers
To provide a sanitary barrier between a subject and the probe, a probe cover that comes in contact with a subject.
A probe and a probe cover of the system shall have shape and dimensions that prevent injury to a subject of any age.
A probe cover shall not increase laboratory errors whose limits are set in 5.3.1.
Labeling and Marking (Instruments and Accessories)
Thermometer and Accessories
A thermometer shall clearly indicate the units of its temperature scale.
requirements.notes: See 'Instruction for Use' of the User's Manual

requirements.description: An IR thermometer housing shall be clearly marked with the trade name or type of the device, or both, model designation, name of the manufacturer or distributor, and lot number or serial number.

An IR thermometer intended for professional use shall be conspicuously labelled with an indication of the unadjusted or adjusted mode(s), or both, that correspond to the temperature value(s) capable of being displayed by the instrument.
Probe Covers Package

The package shall state the name and type of the enclosed products, name of the manufacturer or distributor, lot number or serial number, and expiration date (if the probe covers have limited shelf life).
The thermometer model(s) for which the covers are intended for use shall be specified on the probe cover package.
The package shall state whether the probe cover is intended for single use or multiple use.

Any probe cover handling, application, storage, or cleaning procedures which impact the ability of an IR thermometer to meet the requirements for maximum permissible laboratory error specified in 5.3 shall be stated.

The tests are not required for every produced instrument. However, each producer or distributor who represents its instruments as conforming to this specification shall utilize statistically based sampling plans that are appropriate for each particular manufacturing process, in the design qualification of the device, and shall keep such essential records as are necessary to document with a high degree of assurance its claims that all of the requirements of this specification are met.
The manufacturer shall make the sampling plans available upon request.
Laboratory Accuracy Tests

General—Laboratory accuracy tests are intended for verifying compliance of the design and construction of a particular type or model of IR thermometer with the error limitations specified in 5.3 or 5.4, or both.
Blackbody

Under laboratory conditions, an IR thermometer shall be tested against a blackbody standard. A recommended blackbody design is provided in Annex A1. The temperature of a blackbody shall be measured by the IR thermometer being tested in accordance with a procedure recommended by the manufacturer for the particular IR thermometer.
The true temperature of the blackbody shall be monitored by a contact imbedded or immersed thermometer with uncertainty no greater than ± 0.03 °C (±0.05 °F).
A manufacturer may require that an IR thermometer is tested only with a manufacturer-specified blackbody, rather than that described in Annex A1.
Ear Canal Type IR Thermometer

Tests shall be repeated for three blackbody temperatures, t_set within ±0.5 °C (±1 °F) of the following temperatures: 35, 37, and 41 °C (95, 98.6, and 105.8 °F). At each blackbody temperature, the tests shall be repeated under the ambient conditions stated in Table 1.
Prior to the measurements, the IR thermometer shall be stabilized at given conditions of ambient temperature and humidity for a minimum of 30 min or longer if so specified by the manufacturer.

At each combination of operating temperature and humidity in Table 1, at least six measurements shall be taken for each blackbody temperature. The number of readings shall be the same for all combinations. A new disposable probe cover (if applicable) must be used for each test reading. The rate and method of temperature taking shall be in compliance with the manufacturer's recommendations.
The requirements of 5.3 demand that no individual error δj exceeds the specified limits for laboratory error.

In each mode, three data sets shall be formed. Each data set is comprised of values δj obtained at the same blackbody temperature setting by pooling together values for all combinations of operating temperature and humidities obtained at that blackbody temperature. The largest δj is a measure of the laboratory error of a system.

The correction method to arrive at unadjusted temperature tj from readings in adjusted mode(s) shall be used according to the manufacturer's recommendation. Such recommendations shall be available from the manufacturer on request and provided in the service and repair manual, if any (see 7.3).
To comply with this standard, the greatest calculated error δj from all data sets measured and calculated for all display modes shall conform with requirements set forth in 5.3.
Skin Type IR Thermometer
Testing is as specified in 6.1.4 except that blackbody temperatures shall be set within ±1 °C (±2 °F) from the following temperatures: 23, 30, and 38 °C (73, 86, and 100 °F).
The greatest calculated error δj from all data sets shall conform with requirements set forth in 5.4.

Storage Test—To test compliance with storage conditions, an IR thermometer shall be maintained in an environmental chamber at temperature –20 °C (–4 °F), relative humidity below 50 %, for a period of 30 days and at 50 °C (122 °F), relative humidity no less than 75 % noncondensing, for a period of 30 days. After each exposure the IR thermometer shall be tested according to 6.3.2 and 6.3.3.

Clinical Accuracy Tests—This specification does not prescribe an actual method for determining clinical accuracy or establish specifications for values which characterize clinical accuracy. Manufacturers shall perform clinical accuracy testing in accordance with methods acceptable to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. An example of a method which may be used for this purpose is provided in X2.3.
Error limit for IR thermometer measurement accuracy (referenced in shock test error evaluation)
Alternative error limit for IR thermometer measurement accuracy (referenced in shock test error evaluation)
Requirement for IR thermometer shock/drop resistance (referenced in shock test)
Requirement for electromagnetic susceptibility temperature excursion deviation
Specification for unadjusted mode setting of IR thermometer
The probe of the electrostatic discharge device shall touch one of the electrically conductive parts on the device.
The level of discharge shall be 2, 4, and 6 kV.
After electrostatic discharge, the IR thermometer shall be tested according to the procedures of 6.3.2 and 6.3.3.
Documentation
Identification

Producers and distributors may include a statement of compliance in conjunction with their name and address on product labels or associated printed materials. Suggested statement: 'This infrared thermometer meets requirements established in ASTM Standard (E1965-98). Full responsibility for the conformance of this product to the standard is assumed by (name and address of producer or distributor).' In the event one or more provisions are not met, a cautionary statement shall be included.
The IR thermometer shall be identified as intended for professional or consumer use, or both, as applicable.
Instruction Manual
An instruction manual shall be provided and contain the system specifications including, but not limited to, specified items.

The instruction manual shall indicate the type and availability of a blackbody recommended for verifying laboratory or clinical accuracy, if only such type is required by the manufacturer as addressed in 6.1.3.3.

The instruction manual shall specify whether the probe cover is intended for single use or multiple use. If multiple use is allowed, cleaning instructions and criteria for determining when a probe cover should be discarded shall be specified. Cleaning instructions shall be adequate to prevent cross-contamination between patients.

The instruction manual shall inform the user of differences in the accuracy of measurements obtained with IR thermometers versus contact thermometers (mercury-in-glass and electronic thermometers). Such differences shall include description of anticipated error sources associated with disposable or reusable probe covers and sleeves, operators' technique, anatomical variations, earwax buildups, subject cooperation, etc. The instruction manual shall conspicuously include the statement: 'ASTM laboratory accuracy requirements in the display range of 37 to 39 °C (98 to 102 °F) for IR thermometers is ± 0.2 °C (±0.4 °F), whereas for mercury-in-glass and electronic thermometers, the requirement per ASTM Standards E667-86 and E1112-86 is ± 0.1 °C (±0.2 °F).'
Service and Repair Manual
A detailed service manual shall be made available if user service or repair is permitted by the manufacturer.
A service manual shall disclose values of instrumentation or combined site offsets, or both.
A service manual shall provide a method of arriving at unadjusted readings from temperatures displayed in an adjusted mode.

Accuracy Determination — A manufacturer shall make available upon request specific instructions for tests to determine the laboratory error, clinical bias, and clinical repeatability of an IR thermometer. When describing how clinical tests are performed, the manufacturer shall disclose the profile of subject groups tested, including age and febrile status. A detailed procedure for taking reference temperatures also shall be disclosed.

requirements.description: Cleaning and disinfection of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEM

sub_requirements.description: The surfaces of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES that can become contaminated with body fluids during NORMAL CONDITION or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION shall be designed to allow for cleaning and disinfection or cleaning and sterilization
sub_requirements.reference: See 'Caution' of the Operation Guide; IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 11.6.7 and IEC 60601-1-11:2015, Clause B

sub_requirements.description: The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may be dismantled during the decontamination PROCESS
ACCESSORIES not intended for re-use are exempt from this requirement

CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE ENCLOSURES shall be designed to allow for surface cleaning and disinfection to reduce to acceptable levels the RISK of infection of OPERATORS, bystanders, or the PATIENT
Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES shall comply with ISO 17664:2004 and ISO 14937:2009 and shall be disclosed in the instructions for use

Check compliance by inspection of the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Clean and disinfect 100 times in accordance with the methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained. Confirm that the MANUFACTURER has evaluated the effects of multiple PROCESS cycles and the effectiveness of those cycles.

The technical description contains the following required information

Solid insulation forming a MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION shall comply with dielectric strength test of 8.8 at test voltage of Table 6, or requirements of IEC 60950-1 / IEC 62368-1 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION.
CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES forming a MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION shall comply with limits of Tables 13 to 16 (inclusive) or requirements of IEC 60950-1 / IEC 62368-1 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION.
PROTECTIVE EARTH CONNECTIONS forming a MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION shall comply with Cl. 8.6 or requirements of IEC 60950-1 / IEC 62368-1 for protective earthing.
Y2 capacitor (IEC 60384-14) is considered one MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION.
Y1 capacitor (IEC 60384-14) is considered two MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION.
Two capacitors used in series, each RATED for total WORKING VOLTAGE across the pair with same NOMINAL capacitance, considered as insulation means.
Optocouplers complying with IEC 60747-5-5:2007 or later edition considered equivalent to requirements in 8.8.2 and 8.9.3.

PATIENT CONNECTIONS of F-TYPE APPLIED PART shall be separated from all other parts by equivalent to one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION for a WORKING VOLTAGE equal to maximum MAINS VOLTAGE, complying with limit for PATIENT LEAKAGE CURRENT at 110% of max.
Separation requirement not applied between multiple functions of a single F-TYPE APPLIED PART.
Classification as TYPE BF, CF, or DEFIBRILLATION-PROOF applies to one entire APPLIED PART.
A protective device connected between PATIENT CONNECTIONS of an F-TYPE APPLIED PART and ENCLOSURE to protect against excessive voltages shall not operate below 500 V r.m.s.

PATIENT CONNECTIONS of a TYPE B APPLIED PART not PROTECTIVELY EARTHED shall be separated by one MEANS OF PATIENT PROTECTION from metal ACCESSIBLE PARTS not PROTECTIVELY EARTHED, except when metal ACCESSIBLE PART is physically close to APPLIED PART and can be regarded as part of APPLIED PART.
Solid insulating materials with a safety function shall withstand dielectric strength test voltages
Resistance to heat retained by all insulation and insulating partition walls during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE of ME EQUIPMENT

Insulating characteristics and mechanical strength of all MEANS OF PROTECTION not likely to be impaired by environmental stresses including deposition of dirt resulting from wear of parts within EQUIPMENT, potentially reducing CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES below 8.9

CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES are to values in Tables 12 to 16 (inclusive); insulation between parts of opposite polarity of MAINS PART on supply mains side of any mains fuse or OVER-CURRENT RELEASE, one MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION to values in Table 13, Table 14 and Table 16

sub_requirements.description: The surfaces of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES that can become contaminated with body fluids during NORMAL CONDITION or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION shall be designed to allow for cleaning and disinfection or cleaning and sterilization (additional requirements found in IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 11.6.7 and IEC 60601-1-11:2015, Clause B)
The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may be dismantled during the decontamination PROCESS
ACCESSORIES not intended for re-use are exempt from this requirement

CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE ENCLOSURES shall be designed to allow for surface cleaning and disinfection to reduce to acceptable levels the RISK of infection of OPERATORS, bystanders, or the PATIENT
Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES shall comply with ISO 17664:2004 and ISO 14937:2009 and shall be disclosed in the instructions for use

Check compliance by inspection of the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Clean and disinfect 100 times in accordance with methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained. Confirm that the MANUFACTURER has evaluated the effects of multiple PROCESS cycles and the effectiveness of those cycles.

requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Laboratory Accuracy Tests
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: General—Laboratory accuracy tests are intended for verifying compliance of the design and construction of a particular type or model of IR thermometer with the error limitations specified in 5.3 or 5.4, or both.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Blackbody
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Under laboratory conditions, an IR thermometer shall be tested against a blackbody standard. The temperature of a blackbody shall be measured by the IR thermometer being tested in accordance with a procedure recommended by the manufacturer for the particular IR thermometer.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: The true temperature of the blackbody shall be monitored by a contact imbedded or immersed thermometer with uncertainty no greater than ±0.03 °C (±0.05 °F).
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: A manufacturer may require that an IR thermometer is tested only with a manufacturer-specified blackbody, rather than that described in Annex A1.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Ear Canal Type IR Thermometer
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Tests shall be repeated for three blackbody temperatures set within ±0.5 °C (±1 °F) of the following temperatures: 35, 37, and 41 °C (95, 98.6, and 105.8 °F). At each blackbody temperature, the tests shall be repeated under the ambient conditions stated in Table 1.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Prior to the measurements, the IR thermometer shall be stabilized at given conditions of ambient temperature and humidity for a minimum of 30 min or longer if so specified by the manufacturer.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: At each combination of operating temperature and humidity in Table 1, at least six measurements shall be taken for each blackbody temperature t_BB. The number of readings shall be the same for all combinations. A new disposable probe cover (if applicable) must be used for each test reading. The rate and method of temperature taking shall be in compliance with the manufacturer's recommendations.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: The requirements of 5.3 demand that no individual error δj exceeds the specified limits for laboratory error.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: In each mode, three data sets shall be formed. Each data set is comprised of values δj obtained at the same blackbody temperature setting by pooling together values for all combinations of operating temperature and humidities obtained at that blackbody temperature. The largest δj is a measure of the laboratory error of a system.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: The correction method to arrive at unadjusted temperature tj from readings in adjusted mode(s) shall be used according to the manufacturer's recommendation. Such recommendations shall be available from the manufacturer on request and provided in the service and repair manual, if any (see 7.3).
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: To comply with this standard, the greatest calculated error δj from all data sets measured and calculated for all display modes shall conform with requirements set forth in 5.3.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Skin Type IR Thermometer
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Testing is as specified in 6.1.4 except that blackbody temperatures shall be set within ±1 °C (±2 °F) from the following temperatures: 23, 30, and 38 °C (73, 86, and 100 °F).
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: The greatest calculated error δj from all data sets shall conform with requirements set forth in 5.4.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Storage Test—To test compliance with storage conditions, an IR thermometer shall be maintained in an environmental chamber at temperature –20 °C (–4 °F), relative humidity below 50%, for a period of 30 days and at 50 °C (122 °F), relative humidity no less than 75% noncondensing, for a period of 30 days. After each exposure the IR thermometer shall be tested according to 6.3.2 and 6.3.3.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Clinical Accuracy Tests—This specification does not prescribe an actual method for determining clinical accuracy or establish specifications for values which characterize clinical accuracy. Manufacturers shall perform clinical accuracy testing in accordance with methods acceptable to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: IR thermometers not capable of producing continuous temperature readings shall have their circuitry modified to allow for continuous monitoring of the IR and reference temperature signals. The peak excursions of the monitored IR and reference temperature signals measured during frequency sweep interval shall be recalculated to represent the corresponding temperature excursions. On request, the manufacturer shall make available the method of the circuit modification.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: IR thermometers having digital output shall have their signal monitored at the output of the analog-to-digital converter.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Non-conductive and dielectric connections (for example, fiber-optic) shall be used between the IR thermometer and all test equipment so as to minimize perturbations of the electromagnetic field.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements.description: Calculated temperature excursions shall deviate from one another by value no greater than required by 5.6.6.
requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

requirements._source: 实验报告/草稿/ETX202303-07-078-04 PT9L红外体温计( ASTM E 1965-98 2023 test report).pdf.md

plan_tasks.instructions: 1.左手持1PCS温度传感器，右手使用偏口钳将传感器凸点减掉；2、将温度传感器装入散热金属套；3、将散热金属套，装入压块；4、将安装好的探头，装入传感器压合工装内；5、盖上传感器压合工装上盖；6、将压合工装放置气动压合工装指定位置；7、双手同时压下气动压合工装上的两个按钮；8、取出压合完成的传感器。
inspection_requirements: 不得用手触摸传感器镜片
剪点到位
外观无破损、脏污等不良
拿取传感器时，不得抓取传感器腿，以免造成传感器腿粘连、弯曲影响传感器板装配
探头放置平稳
压合后高度：14.1±0.1mm
传感器、散热套无松动现象
设备压力调节0.6±0.05MPa，时间调节在3±1秒

plan_tasks.purpose: 检测贴片的元件功能、性能、虚焊、连焊
equipment: 电源：输出电压5±0.1V，最大输出电流500mA，电流指示精度0.01mA
plan_tasks.instructions: 1、上电后两个LED灯D1和D2全亮，屏幕显示CB1，然后显示软件版本号，2s后进入休眠，两个LED灯熄灭，显示黑屏，操作人员查看休眠电流，应小于50uA；2、按下按键B1唤醒，两个LED点亮，LCD全显，再次按下按键保存，CB1完成；3、若自检未通过，屏幕显示Er1。
inspection_requirements: 电池电压在2.7V到3.3V之间
红外传感器测温应在10℃到40℃之间
休眠电流应小于50uA
自检失败时LCD显示Er1错误提示

tests.item: 初始化功能
tests.condition: 上电后或关机态按按键开机
tests.expected_value: 1.体温计能开机并打开LCD显示；2.MCU系统功能初始化，配置相关模块和功能设置，读取EEPROM存储信息
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: 关机功能
tests.condition: 测量结束后无按键操作15秒；模式设置界面无按键操作3秒
tests.expected_value: 1.达15秒后关闭外设，单片机进入低功耗状态；2.模式设置界面3秒后自动关机
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: LCD显示功能
tests.condition: 首次上电、测量完成、发烧提示场景
tests.expected_value: 1.首次上电LCD全屏显示3秒；2.测量完成后LCD显示测量温度结果、单位、电量等信息；3.结合测试结果给出发烧提示，用背光颜色区分
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: 蜂鸣器提示功能
tests.condition: 测试完成、设置完成、按键操作时
tests.expected_value: 1.首次上电时蜂鸣器长鸣；2.成功长鸣，发烧连续四次短鸣；3.模式设置界面选择时短鸣，确认后长鸣
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: 低电压检测功能
tests.expected_value: 1.电压2.5V–2.7V时LCD提示低电压并保存低电状态；2.电压小于2.5V时LCD提示超低电压后关机
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: 测量模式设置功能
tests.condition: 开机状态下短按设置按键
tests.expected_value: 1.短按设置按键切换测量模式；2.按下测量按键保存当前模式并完成一次测量；3.15s无操作关机
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: 单位切换功能
tests.condition: 长按测量按键8秒后进入单位切换
tests.expected_value: 出现单位图标闪烁，短按切换单位，长按2秒后图标停止闪烁，3秒后关机；进入设置后15秒无操作关机
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: 测量功能
tests.condition: 短按测量按键或长按2秒进行深度测量
tests.expected_value: 1.短按1秒内完成测量，蜂鸣器提示，LCD显示结果；2.深度测量长按2秒后完成，蜂鸣器提示，LCD显示结果
tests._source: 11 T1样机/4 构建和编码E0 23.11.via_lo_html.clean.md

tests.item: 错误检测功能
tests.condition: 工作环境温度超出范围或测量结果超出量程
tests.expected_value: 1.环境温度超出10~40℃时LCD闪烁显示"Err"；2.测温大于42.9℃或小于32℃时提示"---℃"，不显示结果

tests.item: 记忆功能

tests.item: 皮肤刺激试验
tests.condition: 新西兰白色纯种大白兔（雄性，3只），浸提条件：0.9%氯化钠注射液，37℃，72h，浸提比例3cm²:1mL，表面积222.684cm²，浸提体积74.2mL；敷贴4小时，于取下后1h、24h、48h、72h观察
tests.expected_value: 皮肤反应记分系统（红斑0-4分，水肿0-4分，最高8分）
tests.actual_result: 极性浸提液在兔皮肤反应类型为无刺激作用
tests.pass_criteria: 参照GB/T 16886.10-2017评价皮肤刺激反应
tests.instrument: 电子秤(SDWH442)、卧式大容量恒温振荡器(SDWH897)、钢直尺(SDWH463)、立式压力蒸汽灭菌器(SDWH2097)
tests.environment: 室温18~26℃，相对湿度30%~70%，每天12小时光照
tests._source: 11 T1样机/生物相容性/同PT5生物相容性报告/PT5-生物相容性-皮肤刺激1-SDWH-M201905262-4.pdf.md

tests.item: 兔皮肤原发性刺激试验（极性浸提液）
tests.condition: 观察时间点：24±2h、48±2h、72±2h；试验动物3只；每只动物2个试验点
tests.expected_value: 原发性刺激指数≤0.4（极轻微）或无刺激
tests.actual_result: 试验组及阴性对照组所有动物在全部时间点红斑和水肿记分均为0，极性最终记分为0
tests.pass_criteria: 依据表2：平均记分0~0.4为极轻微，5~8为重度；阳性对照极性最终记分5.6（有效）
tests.environment: 苏州大学卫生与环境技术研究所

tests.item: 皮肤刺激试验（非极性/芝麻油浸提）
tests.condition: 新西兰白色纯种大白兔3只（雄性），背部脊柱两侧去毛区域，将0.5 mL浸提液滴于2.5 cm×2.5 cm吸收性纱布片，贴敷至少4小时；浸提条件：37℃，72h，浸提比例3 cm²:1 mL，浸提介质芝麻油；室温18~26℃，相对湿度30%~70%
tests.expected_value: 无刺激作用
tests.actual_result: 试验样品非极性浸提液在兔皮肤反应类型为无刺激作用

tests.name: Laboratory Accuracy Tests
tests.description: Tests intended for verifying compliance of the design and construction of a particular type or model of IR thermometer with the error limitations specified in 5.3 or 5.4, or both.

tests.name: Blackbody Test
tests.description: Under laboratory conditions, an IR thermometer shall be tested against a blackbody standard. The true temperature of the blackbody shall be monitored by a contact imbedded or immersed thermometer with uncertainty no greater than ±0.03 °C (±0.05 °F).

tests.name: Ear Canal Type IR Thermometer Test
tests.description: Tests repeated for three blackbody temperatures (35, 37, 41 °C) within ±0.5 °C. At least six measurements per blackbody temperature per ambient condition combination.

tests.name: Skin Type IR Thermometer Test
tests.description: Testing as specified in 6.1.4 except blackbody temperatures set within ±1 °C (±2 °F) from 23, 30, and 38 °C (73, 86, and 100 °F). Greatest calculated error δj shall conform with requirements in 5.4.

tests.name: Storage Test
tests.description: IR thermometer maintained at –20 °C (<50% RH) for 30 days and at 50 °C (≥75% RH noncondensing) for 30 days. After each exposure, tested per 6.3.2 and 6.3.3.

tests.name: Clinical Accuracy Tests
tests.description: Manufacturers shall perform clinical accuracy testing in accordance with methods acceptable to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

tests.name: Clinical Accuracy Tests - Purpose
tests.description: Evaluation of accuracy of built-in instrumentational or combined site offsets, and performance of an IR thermometer in assessing internal body temperatures from actual subjects.

tests.name: Clinical Accuracy Tests - Reference Sites
tests.description: Tests performed on groups of subjects using an internal body site (e.g., pulmonary artery or sublingual cavity) for reference measurements.

tests.name: Shock Test - Drop Test Procedure
tests.description: IR thermometer subjected to fall from 1 m onto 50 mm thick hardwood board (density >700 kg/m3) on rigid base. Two axes tested: Axis A (optical axis of probe), Axis B (through center of gravity and probe window crossing point). Probe faces down.

tests.name: Shock Test - Post-Drop Measurement Verification
tests.description: Measure blackbody set within ±0.5°C (±1°F) from 37°C (98.6°F), ambient 20-26°C (68-79°F), RH 40-70%. At least 5 measurements with new disposable probe cover per measurement. Unadjusted mode per 5.8.2.2.

tests.name: Shock Test - Error Evaluation
tests.description: Unadjusted temperature value subtracted from blackbody setting. Absolute value of largest error shall be no greater than error limit in 5.3 or 5.4 for blackbody temperature range 36-39°C (96.8-102.2°F).

tests.name: EMC - RF Field Exposure
tests.description: Instrument exposed to modulated electromagnetic RF field per IEC601-1-2 and IEC 1000-4-3.

tests.name: EMC - Field Strength
tests.description: 3 V/m

tests.name: EMC - Carrier Frequency Range
tests.description: 26 MHz to 1 GHz

tests.name: EMC - Frequency Sweep Interval
tests.description: 1 MHz/s minimum

tests.name: EMC - Frequency Interval Dwell Time
tests.description: Greater of 1 s or measurement response time of instrument under test

tests.name: EMC - AM Modulation
tests.description: 80% index with sine wave or 100% with square wave (50% duty cycle). Modulation frequency within each significant signal-processing passband. For devices without defined passband: 1 Hz, 10 Hz, and 1 kHz.

tests.name: EMC - Probe Cover Change
tests.description: No change of probe covers required during electromagnetic compatibility test.

tests.name: EMC - Target Condition
tests.description: IR thermometer probe aimed at target whose surface temperature is within display range. Target does not have to be a blackbody.

tests.name: EMC - Continuous Reading Devices
tests.description: IR thermometers capable of continuous temperature readings shall have readings taken successively and compared during frequency sweep interval.

tests.name: EMC - Non-Continuous Reading Devices
tests.description: Circuitry modified to allow continuous monitoring of IR and reference temperature signals. Peak excursions recalculated to represent temperature excursions.

tests.name: EMC - Digital Output Devices
tests.description: Signal monitored at output of analog-to-digital converter.

tests.name: EMC - Connection Type
tests.description: Non-conductive and dielectric connections (e.g., fiber-optic) used between IR thermometer and test equipment to minimize perturbations of electromagnetic field.

tests.name: EMC - Temperature Excursion Deviation
tests.description: Calculated temperature excursions shall deviate from one another by value no greater than required by 5.6.6.

tests.name: ESD Test - General
tests.description: Effects of electrostatic discharge on accuracy tested per IEC 1000-4-2:1995.

tests.name: ESD Test - Power State
tests.description: IR thermometer shall be in 'power on' state when subjected to electrostatic discharge.

tests.name: ESD Test - Number of Discharges
tests.description: Ten air and ten contact discharges shall be applied.

tests.name: ESD Test - No Exposed Conductive Parts
tests.description: If no exposed electrically conductive parts, only air discharge shall be applied.

tests.name: ESD - Air Discharge Target
tests.description: Discharge aimed at electrically nonconductive part of IR thermometer probe with no probe cover attached.

tests.name: ESD - Air Discharge Level
tests.description: Discharge levels: 2 kV, 4 kV, and 8 kV.
Electrostatic discharge test

tests.test_condition: Power supply voltage: 2.5V; Blackbody setting temperature: 37°C
tests.error_formula: δ = |tj - tBB|, where tj = displayed or calculated value of unadjusted temperature, tBB = true temperature of the blackbody, j = sequential number of a reading
tests.error_description: The largest δj is a measure of the laboratory error of a system.

properties.content: 测试目的：证明用户在仅提供用户说明书的情况下能够正常完成体温测量，确认机器能够满足预期用途和用户需求。

edges._source: 18 设计确认/用户测试/用户现场测试计划 PT9C V1.0.via_lo_html.clean.md

properties.content: 测试方法：1. 采用试产完成的产品样机，仅提供用户说明书，不提供其它附加培训和随机文件以外的材料，模拟用户实际使用环境；2. 由受试用户自行操作完成相应功能，并记录用户操作过程，项目组人员对其操作过程进行评估；3. 对受试用户进行问卷调查，评估其对产品的理解程度和用户说明书的适宜性。

edges._source: 18 设计确认/用户测试/用户现场测试计划 PT9C V1.0.via_lo_html.clean.md

properties.content: 测试要求：1. 采用试产完成的产品样机；2. 测试前向受试用户声明：本测试是对该体温计产品进行测试，不是受试用户个人；3. 参与用户测试的受试用户人群需要是普通用户和专业技术人员组成。受试用户年龄要求12岁以上成人。4. 测试人员不少于9人。性别要求男、女均有，每个性别的比例不低于30%。

edges._source: 18 设计确认/用户测试/用户现场测试计划 PT9C V1.0.via_lo_html.clean.md

properties.content: 测试流程：1. 记录受试用户的年龄、性别等个人信息；2. 提供受试用户被测样机和用户说明书，用户自行学习；3. 用户按照操作要求列表进行测试；4. 测试人员在评审用户现场测试记录表中的用户使用过程记录时，检查用户操作是否正确。

edges._source: 18 设计确认/用户测试/用户现场测试计划 PT9C V1.0.via_lo_html.clean.md

properties.content: 接收准则：通过检查用户现场记录和用户现场测试总结报告，满足下列要求，则视为用户现场测试通过：1. 测试采用了试产完成的产品样机；2. 参加测试的受试者分布应满足上述"3. 测试要求"中d部分的要求；3. 按照本计划的测试方法、测试流程进行用户现场测试；4. 《用户现场测试记录》中无异常测试现象或异常测试现象被解决。

edges._source: 18 设计确认/用户测试/用户现场测试计划 PT9C V1.0.via_lo_html.clean.md

properties.content: 用户现场测试问卷调查表内容：1. 用户说明书可读性；2. 标签的可读性；3. LCD显示内容是否易懂；4. LCD显示是否清楚；5. 安装电池是否容易；6. 按键的易用性；7. 售后服务信息查找；8. 是否提供额外材料。

edges._source: 18 设计确认/用户测试/用户现场测试计划 PT9C V1.0.via_lo_html.clean.md
